notes.title: Release Date + Tiny Teams
notes.notes:
Coming SEPTEMBER 9th, 2025


We're thrilled to announce that Heroes of the Seven Islands officially has a release date!

The game is expected to take players roughly 10-15 hours on their first playthrough. It will be listed for $11.99 USD with a planned launch discount.
[previewyoutube="4Skrsq2USqg;full"][/previewyoutube]
Check out this brand new trailer made to celebrate the occasion, featuring an all new theme for the game composed by the incredibly talented Eric Shumaker (Look Outside).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096725/fc903b31bc6f5c343f5d8f95d23b6c4a9db8c5ff.png"]



We are also incredibly excited to have Heroes of the Seven Islands selected to take part in the Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival 2025! This event is dedicated to small indie game teams. Be sure to check it out to support other solo/small teams and their delightful games!

Be sure to add Heroes of the Seven Islands to your Wishlist. You can try the free demo NOW. And be sure to leave us a review so we can polish the game leading up to the release next month!
